boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named public-facing destinations on the downtown and near-campus corridors surrounding UGA.

cards.title: Read Athens music history underfoot
cards.subtitle: West Washington–North Lumpkin corridor, Downtown Athens
cards.notes: Start at a marked honoree and follow the two-block route bounded by Pulaski, Washington, Lumpkin, and Clayton streets.
cards.short_summary: A downtown walking route recognizing Athens musicians.
cards.evidence_claim: The Athens Music Walk of Fame is a two-square-block downtown area bounded by Pulaski, West Washington, North Lumpkin, and West Clayton streets.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public route; use sidewalks and cross only at marked crossings.

cards.title: Photograph the landmark marquee
cards.subtitle: North Lumpkin Street corridor, Downtown Athens
cards.notes: Pause outside the marquee, then consult the venue calendar before planning a ticketed performance or rooftop visit.
cards.short_summary: A historic downtown performance venue beside the music walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Theatre is at 215 N. Lumpkin St. and the Athens Music Walk of Fame passes its marquee.
cards.access_notes: Performance and rooftop access depend on the current event and venue policies; verify before visiting.

cards.title: See a restored vaudeville theatre
cards.subtitle: West Washington Street corridor, Downtown Athens
cards.notes: Look for the theatre at Hot Corner, then check its calendar for a public performance, tour, or community program.
cards.short_summary: A restored 1910 theatre in Athens’ historic Black business district.
cards.evidence_claim: The Morton Theatre at 195 W. Washington St. opened in 1910 and operates as a community performing-arts space.
cards.access_notes: The building’s listed public office hours are Monday–Friday, noon–6 p.m.; event access varies.

cards.title: Take a self-guided historic-house visit
cards.subtitle: Hoyt Street corridor, Downtown Athens
cards.notes: Enter through the Lyndon House Arts Center entrance and use the posted QR codes for the house’s self-guided audio material.
cards.short_summary: A restored historic house museum within the Lyndon House complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Ware-Lyndon House is a restored house museum at 293 Hoyt St. with self-guided access and free admission.
cards.access_notes: Enter and exit through the Arts Center’s main entrance; the historic front and side entrances are locked.

cards.title: Browse galleries and the arts resource room
cards.subtitle: Hoyt Street corridor, Downtown Athens
cards.notes: Pair the house museum with the arts center galleries, then ask staff about the reference-only arts collection during operating hours.
cards.short_summary: A visual-arts center with galleries and an arts-focused reference room.
cards.evidence_claim: Lyndon House Arts Center includes an arts-related Library Resource Room with reference materials in art history, studio art, and artist business topics.
cards.source_title: Lyndon House Arts Center Library Resource Room
cards.access_notes: Resource-room materials are for on-site reference and are not available for checkout.

cards.title: Use public library services on Baxter
cards.subtitle: Baxter Street corridor, west of campus
cards.notes: Bring a project or browse the library’s public services; check the location page for daily hours and scheduled programs.
cards.short_summary: The main Athens Regional Library location on Baxter Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Athens-Clarke County Library is located at 2025 Baxter Street and lists computers, printing and scanning, local history, teen services, and Wi-Fi.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–9 p.m., Friday–Saturday 9 a.m.–6 p.m., and Sunday 2–6 p.m.

cards.title: Choose a court, trail, or picnic area
cards.subtitle: Sunset Drive corridor, west of campus
cards.notes: Use the walking trail or outdoor courts when available, and check the county page first if you need a scheduled program or facility.
cards.short_summary: A 33-acre city park with varied recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Bishop Park has athletic fields, courts, a playground, pool, tennis courts, walking trail, picnic area, and Athens-Clarke Gymnastics Academy.
cards.access_notes: Park hours are listed as daily from 8 a.m. to sunset; some courts may be reserved for organized activities.

cards.title: Follow the river-side nature trails
cards.subtitle: Dudley Park Road–East Broad Street corridor, east of downtown
cards.notes: Walk the park trails beside Trail Creek and the North Oconee River, using the posted park entrances and daylight hours.
cards.short_summary: A 31-acre riverside park a short walk from downtown and UGA.
cards.evidence_claim: Dudley Park is a 31-acre park at the confluence of Trail Creek and the North Oconee River with nature trails and picnic areas.
cards.access_notes: The county lists daily hours from sunrise to sunset.

cards.title: Walk display gardens and nature trails
cards.subtitle: South Milledge Avenue corridor, south of campus
cards.notes: Use the visitor center as your starting point, then choose a display garden or nature trail and stay on marked routes.
cards.short_summary: UGA’s 323-acre botanical garden and trail destination.
cards.evidence_claim: The State Botanical Garden of Georgia has themed gardens across 323 acres, and its admission and parking are free.
cards.source_title: State Botanical Garden of Georgia: Location, Hours, Parking and Tours
cards.access_notes: Grounds are listed as open daily 7 a.m.–7 p.m., except UGA holidays; visitor-center hours differ.

cards.title: Check the civic venue’s public calendar
cards.subtitle: North Thomas Street corridor, northeast edge of downtown
cards.notes: Review the current event calendar before walking over, then use the venue’s event details to confirm ticketing and entry procedures.
cards.short_summary: Athens’ downtown convention, performance, and event complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The Classic Center is a downtown Athens event venue with a public events calendar.
cards.access_notes: Access and any admission requirements depend on the individual scheduled event.
